image_description: A vintage-style red and cream minibus driving on a city street. The vehicle has a boxy shape, large windshield, side windows, and visible wheels. The background features multi-story buildings with architectural details. The image has a slightly grainy, retro aesthetic.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle clearly exhibits a boxy, compact bus silhouette distinct from full-size coaches, with sufficient height for passenger accommodation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is prominent, and a clear row of rectangular side windows runs along the passenger compartment.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has substantial height relative to its width. A door structure is visible at the front-right side (from viewer's perspective), consistent with minibus design.
The paneling and seams at the front right indicate a door mechanism, likely sliding or folding, typical for this vehicle class.
There is a distinct hood/bonnet section ahead of the windshield, indicating a front-engine layout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is not visible in this angle; only the front and side are shown.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bus features a two-tone red and cream/white livery. There appears to be text/markings on the side, though indistinct due to resolution/style.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible wheels are proportional to a van/minibus chassis, with standard rim designs.
The size and window configuration suggest a capacity consistent with the 4-10 passenger range for a minibus.

artifact_observations.location: Side of the bus, below the windows
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a strip of text or pattern on the lower side panel that resembles writing but is illegible and structurally inconsistent, typical of AI-generated text artifacts.
The glass surfaces lack clear reflections or interior details, appearing somewhat muddy or overly uniform compared to the surrounding metal bodywork.
The vertical lines of the buildings in the background show slight warping and inconsistency in perspective convergence, though subtle.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific vehicle class and distinguish it from similar categories like full-size buses or vans.
To verify the 3D structural integrity of the bus and its spatial relationship with the road and background buildings.
To check for edge bleeding between the bus and the background, and ensure the vehicle is a single coherent object.
To analyze the illegible text artifact on the side of the bus for character-level coherence.
To assess the overall visual quality, noise patterns, and any subtle stylistic inconsistencies.

focus_areas: Structural geometry of the minibus (wheels, windows, doors)
Legibility and structure of side text/markings
Boundary sharpness between bus and background
Consistency of lighting and reflections on glass surfaces
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text-like patterns on the side of the bus; AI often fails to render coherent text here. Also, verify if the wheel alignment and perspective match the road plane accurately, as slight floating or misalignment is common in generated vehicles.
